efforts_note: Effort follows the cost of a wrong answer: routine work gets low, ordinary engineering logic medium, open-ended or high-stakes work high. A category is one (model, effort) pair.

routine.description: everything to do is written down; the change is mechanical or repetitive (apply a known pattern, rename, shorten, archive, tests for a given function); no design choice is left; the checks are given commands

lookup.description: gather and report facts from docs, the web or the code, sources cited; the deliverable is a written answer, never an edit to a file; no decision to take

logic.description: the goal and the decisions are settled, but the work needs reading the code, finding where to change it, and writing code and tests across several files

hard.description: the task itself leaves something open: an unknown cause to find, a choice between options, an unresolved trade-off, concurrency or security, or a design spanning several systems; a question a source answers is lookup, not hard
